# Community code of conduct

ShortcutLauncher contributors are expected to keep project spaces respectful, constructive, and focused on the work.

- Discuss ideas and code without personal attacks or harassment.
- Welcome questions from people with different experience levels.
- Give actionable technical feedback and assume good intent while still protecting users.
- Do not publish another person's private information, credentials, local paths, or user data.
- Do not use project spaces for spam, threats, discrimination, or sexualized conduct.

Maintainers may edit or remove harmful content and may temporarily or permanently restrict participation when necessary. Report conduct issues privately through the route documented in `SECURITY.md`; do not include sensitive details in a public issue.
